metadata.title: Modern Group Portrait in High-Key Interior

recipe.visualDefinition: A symmetrical group portrait of five men in formal black suits seated on a curved white sofa within a bright, high-key white room featuring large panoramic windows overlooking a cloudy blue sky.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between dark formal attire and a stark white environment
Symmetry established by the central figure and flanking pairs
Repetition of vertical window frames creating a rhythmic background
Low-angle perspective emphasizing the stature of the subjects
coreInvariants: High-key lighting with minimal shadows in the environment
Formal black suits with white shirts and dark ties

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Five subjects seated mid-ground, occupying the lower two-thirds of the frame horizontally.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central seated figure and the low circular white table in the foreground.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the central figure, moves outward to the flanking members, then upward to the centered typography.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant white space in the upper third (ceiling/sky) and lower foreground floor.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Pure white (walls, sofa, floor, window frames)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value, low saturation environment contrasted against high-density black subjects.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Numeric characters matching the cap height and stroke weight of the letters

composition.relationshipToImage: placed in the negative space of the ceiling

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used for brand impact; no secondary type needed.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the square-geometric aesthetic and modern feel.
Provides the necessary wide, square proportions.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A high-key wide shot of five men in black suits sitting on a white curved sofa in a bright white room with large windows showing a blue sky. A low white circular table is in the foreground.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add centered uppercase geometric sans-serif text in the upper third of the image with wide letter spacing.

verificationChecks: Is the text centered in the upper white space?
Are the suits deep black without losing texture?
Is the room environment predominantly pure white?
Is the horizon line/window sill level?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the individuals
Any unique brand logos on the clothing
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the white floor and sofa do not bleed into each other excessively.
Check that the sky blue is subtle and does not overpower the white theme.
Verify the text is perfectly horizontal and centered.
Confirm the lighting is even across all five subjects.
recipe.reuseFormula: Symmetrical group portrait + high-key white interior + panoramic windows + formal black attire + centered geometric typography.
